note: The auditable record of which RPCS3 frame backs which Tier B cell. Authored from what each batch's MANIFEST.md says the frame shows (the manifest section is cited in every note), not from file names. `entries` is the input to work/parity-import.ts; the importer rewrites each entry's `applied` block with the cell, the destination reference and provenance paths, and the source and destination sha256 (identity: the importer copies or hard-links, it never converts). An entry's `replaced` field records a deliberate re-import of the same source into the same cell - the map has been imported three times: twice on 2026-10-27 (batch 1, the second run because the first sidecars carried the manifest's typography and the corpus is ASCII) and once on 2026-10-28 with batch 2 added (--replace re-validates and re-copies the nine batch-1 cells from the same sources, sha256 identical, so only the applied blocks move). Batch 2's frames are night frames, so they are filed at night cells and never at the canonical day cell; see native-xmb/audit/PARITY-SCORECARD.md section 11. The images stay under out/parity-references/, which .gitignore excludes, so this file is the committed part: paths and hashes, never firmware pixels.

batches.session: 2026-10-27 22:39:07-23:52 local (America/Chicago), one session in two RPCS3 boots (boot 1 22:39-22:47 ended in an emulator fault; boot 2 22:50-23:52)
batches.frames: 22,400 PNGs: 251 stills + 22,149 burst frames in 19 bursts; every still 1920x1080; burst frames are full-frame 1920x1080 or a documented 1:1 crop
batches.reason: The batch manifest does not state its capture date in the form work/parity-import.ts reads (it looks for a '- Session: <YYYY-MM-DD> <HH:MM>' line; this manifest says 'One capture session, two RPCS3 boots: boot 1 22:39:07 ...' with no date on that line), so the importer refused it as incomplete (exit 2, 'no capture date'). The rig manifest is not edited here. The frames are imported through importManifest, a byte-faithful copy of the batch manifest (same 30,006 bytes plus exactly one inserted '- Session:' bullet, sha256 above) whose date is the local capture date evidenced by the batch's own logs/refcap-*.log stamps (2026-10-27T22:39 to 23:21) and the section 8 restore audit - 2026-10-27 local is 2026-10-28 UTC, which is the folder name. If the rig adds that line to the real manifest, re-running the importer against it replaces the sidecars' source.manifest with the primary file and changes nothing else. Only stills are eligible: the bursts are crops of an animated region, not full frames. The console clock was left at its night time and nothing was committed (manifest 8), so every eligible frame is a night frame, filed at night cells and never at a canonical day cell; the theme is original on the strength of lists/theme-page-rest.png (Theme/Color/Background/Font all read Original), not assumed.
